description:
I'm back with another skin. this time it's Super Saiyan 4 Goku on Sett. I had lots of fun making this skin. Based on my Summoner name, you could tell this one was coming. I also saw lots of comments on my unlisted Vergil video. So this time I'll make the video public so I can check it more often.
Skin includes:
-Custom model
-Custom textures
-Custom visual effects
-Custom voice lines
-Custom sound effects
-and some animations were changed as well
